title: Systems Biology Integration of Glycomics and Cytoskeletal Transport Networks in Arabidopsis thaliana (OSD-615 Follow-Up)
description: Comprehensive multi-omics systems biology data integration, interactive web dashboard, and dynamic simulation modeling connecting high-throughput cell wall glycomics from NASA OSD-615 (APEX-03-1) with cytoskeletal motors, vesicular trafficking machinery, and companion spaceflight RNA-Seq datasets in Arabidopsis thaliana. Includes sparse PLS regression, WGCNA module-trait analysis, STRING/AraNet PPI networks, stochastic Monte Carlo vesicle transport modeling, and a complete npj Microgravity-formatted manuscript.
